title: Anterior arterial variation: eight-volunteer comparison
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Compare the same arterial region across eight healthy-volunteer source examples. Record visible course, paired-side context, label coverage and the evidence supporting each interpretation.

views.prompt: Follow the right and left A1 courses from the source internal carotid terminations toward the communicating region. Compare their displayed course and relative appearance in adjacent MRA sections. Record the case, side, visible course, continuity across sections and supplied segment labels. Describe uncertainty where image signal and annotation coverage differ.
